effect_correctness.unit: grouped-OOF or outer-fold-held-out local effect row
effect_correctness.equivalent: nonbeneficial for deployment and separately reported
effect_correctness.uncertain_invalid: excluded from accuracy denominator and fully reported

action_correctness.oracle: quality-beneficial AND no material harm AND active client-latency constraint-feasible

confirmatory_local_slice: sealed PM decision before unchosen counterfactual generation; never feeds training or threshold
interactive_caveat: ESC and DG local correctness is myopic fixed-prefix evidence, not global sequential-policy regret
